name: Piper Lessac (medium, en-US)
summary: Single-speaker U.S. English VITS neural text-to-speech voice for the Piper engine, trained from scratch on the Blizzard 2013 Lessac corpus.

license.notes: Upstream declares no SPDX identifier: the voice MODEL_CARD names only the Blizzard 2013 Lessac dataset license at the url above, whose text was not retrievable from the verification environment; Piper upstream adds that voices are 'intended for personal use and text to speech research only' and that it imposes no additional restrictions - review the dataset license before commercial use.

notes: Exercised in-session on Linux x86_64 with piper-tts 1.6.0 (OHF-Voice piper1-gpl) + onnxruntime 1.28.0 on CPU: the 2023 voice format loads unmodified and synthesized 5.888 s of non-silent 16 kHz mono audio. Upstream MODEL_CARD states 22,050 Hz, but the shipped config and every produced WAV are 16000 Hz - sampleRateHz records the measured value. Unpacks to en-us-lessac-medium.onnx + .onnx.json + MODEL_CARD; requirements are approximate (diskMb = extracted bytes, ramMb = measured peak RSS of the CLI process).
